reviewer: independent native review agent (id 3c8d2129-b23b-4e26-9254-353e108439ac); the Claude Code backend failed twice at the product layer (exit 1, invalid-result) and is recorded as unavailable for this review
reviewedScope: the full MC-19 scope-proposal diff 3490c0f..b53f67e, the proposal documents, datasets, validator and tests, and the baseline governance state

findings.problem: The no-implementation guard was bypassable: implementationProblems() was exported but never called; checks 05-08 used git diff only, which ignores untracked files and out-of-path committed implementation; the tests never exercised the git/file checks.
findings.requiredFix: Scan git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all union the full committed diff against the baseline, allowlist only the proposal package, wire implementationProblems, and add adversarial tests for untracked and out-of-path files.

findings.problem: The stop statement said no MC-19 code or dataset was created, but the package deliberately adds a validator, tests, documents and datasets.
findings.requiredFix: Qualify the statement as no product/implementation code, route, page, form, endpoint, lead store or public artefact; list the validator, tests, documents and datasets as package artefacts.

findings.problem: implementationBlockers included P03, but Option A does not require the privacy gate and P03 blocks only the deferred enquiry/lead-flow sub-scope; the D03 table repeated the contradiction.
findings.requiredFix: Remove P03 from implementationBlockers, add an explicit enquiryFlowBlockers list, and relabel the D03 tables.

findings.problem: The absence of the MC-19 Master Prompt was inferred from the placeholder registry. MC-18 records that its own authorising prompt existed but was never committed, so repository absence cannot prove non-issuance.
findings.requiredFix: State P01 as asserted from the milestone mandate and the absence of a recorded approval, disclose the uncommitted-prompt limitation, and rely on the independently verifiable blockers for the stop decision.

findings.problem: D07 promised a review update before final delivery while the review was still PENDING, and the manifest counted five datasets while the package has six JSON files.
findings.requiredFix: Record the review result and correction status in D07 and review-findings, and reconcile the dataset count (six including manifest.json).
